'''Atomic incinerators''' were used by [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]]. Debris and wreckage were fed into the atomic incinerators where the material was broken down and useful substances were extracted for recycling.<ref name="JAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
